items.title: Novo Nordisk strikes second licensing deal since frosty capital-markets day
items.description: Novo Nordisk on Tuesday struck its second licensing deal since receiving a poor reception from investors after presenting its long-term strategy.

items.title: Celebrity couple Jenny McCarthy and Donnie Wahlberg are selling $2.8 million Illinois home
items.description: Singer Donnie Wahlberg and actress Jenny McCarthy  have owned the St. Charles residence for more than a decade, having purchased it for $1.1 million in 2015.

items.title: Kris Jenner delists $13.5 million home that was featured in ‘Keeping Up With the Kardashians’
items.description: Kardashian matriarch Kris Jenner has once again removed her Hidden Hills, Calif., mansion from the market—after wavering over the sale.

items.title: A month ago, this JPMorgan team urged caution on stocks. Now it’s going all in on tech.
